summary: Iteration 5 — Budgets CRUD, Settings Profile/Company (localStorage), Reports professional template + edit-summary + print-to-PDF, TopNav/AlertCard alignment, mobile layout. Backend: 5/5 pytest PASS in test_iteration5.py: GET /api/finance/budgets returns seeded list; POST creates with/without actual (defaults to 0); DELETE returns {ok:true} and record is absent on subsequent GET; 422 on missing budgeted. Frontend: Login OK. TopNav — global-search-btn y=15 h=36, quick-add-btn y=15 h=36 (identical baseline) ✓. Dashboard AlertCards — action/ask-ai pairs share identical top within each row (1093.6, 1228.8, 1363.9) ✓. Budgeting — bdg-new opens modal (bdg-form), category='Other' reveals bdg-custom-cat, bdg-submit creates row (bdg-TEST_UI_xxx visible, modal closed); hover+bdg-del-{cat}+dialog-accept removes row ✓. Settings — profile-edit + profile-save persists tb_profile, company-edit + company-save persists tb_company, both survive reload ✓. Reports — #tb-report-doc present; cover header contains 'TECHNOBIZ SYSTEMS · SMART ERP', 'P&L Statement', 'Period Month', 'Generated 2 May 2026', 'Prepared by Aarav Mehta', 'GSTIN 27AAACT2727Q1ZV'; AI executive summary 742 chars rendered; edit-summary → summary-textarea → save-summary shows 'EDITED_SUMMARY_TEST' with 'Edited locally' marker; export-pdf click stubbed window.print and did not throw ✓. Mobile (390x844) — sidebar display:none, bottom nav present, Quick Add FAB present, PageHeader flex-direction:column (stacks), /inventory scrollWidth==clientWidth (no horizontal overflow on body) ✓.

design_issues.screen: Reports.jsx (both bar and pie Recharts containers)
issues: Recharts emits repeated console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Fires ~20+ times per report render. Container likely has no explicit min-height/min-width when the ResponsiveContainer's parent briefly has 0 height during initial layout. Fix: wrap Recharts in a parent with min-h-[220px] or set a fixed height on ResponsiveContainer.

action_items: LOW: Suppress Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on /reports by setting an explicit min-height on the chart wrappers (e.g., className='h-[240px]' on the div containing ResponsiveContainer). Purely a log-noise issue, no visible regression.

VERIFY (optional): On mobile viewport /finance/budgeting occasionally showed a prolonged 'Loading…' on a second navigation during the same session (transient, not reproducible on desktop). Not a functional blocker — all Budgeting flows verified on desktop viewport.

NOTE: Toggle alignment regression on /settings/access-control — could not be re-verified this run because the role list rendered empty on a viewport-switched navigation (timing). Iteration 4 already confirmed this works; no code change since, so treating as still PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx downloadPDF uses window.print which is hard to unit-test; button click does not throw ✓. Good that #tb-report-doc exists and @media print CSS scopes output to this element.
Budgeting.jsx — CreateBudgetModal correctly handles 'Other' custom category and stopPropagation on form; hover-revealed delete uses window.confirm (consistent with other pages).

Settings.jsx Profile/Company persistence is localStorage-only (as per user choice) — save handler writes on click and values survive reload ✓. Consider adding a PATCH /api/users/me endpoint in future for cross-device sync.
server.py /api/finance/budgets has no input validation on negative budgeted/actual values — consider ge=0 on BudgetIn fields (Pydantic Field(..., ge=0)).
server.py delete_budget returns {ok:True} even if bid does not exist (delete_one silently no-ops). Consider 404 when deleted_count==0 for a cleaner contract.

Budgeting.jsx — data-testid on row uses raw category name (bdg-{category}). Works for ASCII but will break if a category contains quotes or spaces — consider slugifying. Current 'Other' + custom name like 'TEST UI 123' would put spaces in the attribute.
Reports.jsx edit-summary state is local only (resets on navigation) — expected per user choice. No backend persistence required.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on reviewed flows (Budgeting CRUD, Settings Profile+Company localStorage, Reports cover+summary+edit+print, TopNav alignment, AlertCard alignment, mobile sidebar/bottom-nav/FAB/header-stacking/no-overflow)

seed_data_creation: pytest test_iteration5.py creates TEST_* budgets and deletes them within each test (net-new: 0). Playwright UI test created one TEST_UI_{ts} budget and deleted it via the hover delete button.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-5 backend+frontend flows pass. Key selectors: bdg-new/bdg-form/bdg-category/bdg-custom-cat (shown when category='Other')/bdg-period/bdg-amount/bdg-actual/bdg-submit, row bdg-{category}, delete bdg-del-{category} (hover-revealed, window.confirm). Settings: profile-edit|save|cancel, company-edit|save|cancel → writes localStorage keys tb_profile / tb_company. Reports: export-pdf triggers window.print (stub it in tests); edit-summary → summary-textarea → save-summary | reset-summary; #tb-report-doc is the print target. Mobile viewport 390x844: sidebar display:none, Quick Add FAB + bottom-nav + PageHeader flex-column all working. Recharts width(-1) warning is cosmetic only.
